phases.title: Context
phases.body: Understand the human on the other end and the channel they use.

phases.title: Floor
phases.body: Specify what the agent must declare, and what it must never pretend.

phases.title: Surface
phases.body: Build the persona above the floor: a name, a voice, true capabilities.

phases.title: Scrutiny
phases.body: Test it like a recorded call, a forwarded transcript, a pulled log.

entry.title: Commission
entry.body: Plan the agent under HAR: a role, a tenant, and the manifesto read first.

exit.text: Trust that holds up under scrutiny
